text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—The Umamusume Rehabilitation Center. 
There, today as well, a lone horsegirl 
undergoes rehab aiming for her comeback.
choice_data_list: You've got this, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Well then, I'm heading in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oof... hup...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
After a sufficient period of complete 
rest, her 
rehabilitation began. First starting with 
pool walks, 
which put minimal strain on her legs—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
She undergoes periodic examinations that 
can take 
over an hour at a time. 
And after persevering patiently through 
all that—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Soaking in the hot springs warms her body 
and eases 
the muscle stiffness from rehab. 
Rehabilitation, 
examinations, hot springs... That's her 
current routine."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Would you mind sharing 
her current status with us?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Certainly. Right now, we are assessing 
the right 
timing to transition from rehabilitation 
back to standard training."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"And... that's a wrap on our feature 
coverage! 
Thank you so much for your cooperation 
on such short notice!"
choice_data_list: (Whew, that got my heart racing...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe. 
Good work, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to invite you to relax and join 
me 
in the footbath... but then again..."
choice_data_list:
It's meant for rehabilitation, after 
all...

It's meant for rehabilitation, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, nobody else is using it right now, 
so feel free to go ahead! Please, be my 
guest."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Really?! 
Well then... please, take a seat next to 
me."
choice_data_list: Ah... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe. 
It's nice and warm, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I soaked in the footbath, a gentle 
warmth 
spread through my entire body... 
At the same time, renewed motivation 
surged within me.
choice_data_list: (...Alright, I've got work to do too!)
(...Alright, I've got work to do too!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continued coordinating with the doctor 
on training 
plans for once we returned to Tracen 
Academy. 
Her test results looked great, and 
progress was smooth.
choice_data_list:
(I'll definitely see her through to a 
complete comeback!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst those continuous days of 
rehabilitation— 
we received a message from some familiar 
faces. 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text: Daring Tact~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone...?!  
What are you doing here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"We reached out to your Trainer, 
and they sorted out all the arrangements 
for us!"
choice_data_list: I'm glad you all made it here safely.

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Well, having everyone back home chip in 
to help 
made all the difference."

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"It really did. The moment we decided to 
head to the mainland, 
everyone took every health and safety 
precaution imaginable... 
Saying, 'Make sure you deliver our 
feelings to her too.'"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! Everyone loaded us up with 
mountains 
of souvenirs for you!  
Come on, let's show her the haul~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Is this... Grade-1 Hidaka kelp?! 
This is gift-grade quality...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing's too good for you! Rehab's 
tough, right? 
Kelp is packed with nutrients, so eat 
plenty 
and keep at it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Even though everyone told me not to 
push 
myself too hard, I—"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that reminds me! That's what we 
wanted to say. 
Daring Tact—thank you, from the bottom of 
our hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"If it gets too painful, you can always 
come home. 
How we feel about you will never change. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to keep cheering for you as 
you give it your all... 
You have no idea how much happiness that 
brings us!"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Next, I want to go up to the 
top 
of that mountain over there! 
Don't worry, I can keep going!"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"We've been chasing after you since you 
were tiny, 
so we know just how tough you really are 
better than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
If anyone can overcome this, it's you, 
Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"You've truly become an amazing horsegirl, 
Daring Tact. 
Loved by so many people... 
You soared far higher than any of us could 
have dreamed."

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"You belong to everyone now. 
Live up to those hopes, and give it your 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. 
Thank you so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text: Hehe. No, thank YOU—truly!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(They gave me so much strength... 
When really, I'm the one who should be 
giving them strength...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Another 'thank you.' 
I've received yet another one."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I have to give back all that gratitude. 
...Hehe, it's an endless circle, isn't 
it—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. 
I see."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It's circulating. 
Everything is—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, as I went out for a walk with 
Daring Tact— 
a pleasant breeze signaling the end of 
spring 
gently blew past us.
choice_data_list: It's a lovely night.
It's a lovely night.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It truly is... I can feel everything just 
existing 
as it is, breathing at its own peaceful 
pace."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was in Hidaka, I've loved 
nights like this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The murmuring stream, the whisper of the 
wind... 
the sound of creatures treading on 
branches. 
Signs of life are all around us."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"In this world, countless lives exist like 
stars in the sky... 
entwined in intricate ways, giving life to 
one another."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I am part of that cycle of life too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My family. 
The local folks who have watched over me 
since I was small."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The grand nature of Hidaka, 
which taught me everything about what it 
means to live..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone who has shared their warm 
kindness with me 
since stepping into the Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "And... Tore-san, who found me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Everything I am is sustained by 
all the encounters I have been blessed 
with."
choice_data_list: ...But it isn't one-sided.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I believe I am also playing a part 
in sustaining everyone else."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That's why 
'thank you' keeps circulating..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I don't ever want this cycle to end.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"More than the gratitude everyone gives 
me, 
I want to repay them with even more 
gratitude..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"To become stronger than I was before the 
injury, 
and shine even brighter than last year— 
that is my dream now."
choice_data_list: Don't worry, that's what I'm here for.
Don't worry, that's what I'm here for.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tore-san...
choice_data_list:
Let's return to the turf at your very 
best!

Let's return to the turf at your very 
best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. 
I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact threw herself into rehab with 
renewed fervor. 
Without rushing, yet putting her heart 
into every step, 
her dedication bore fruit—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"—It looks like you're completely clear 
to return to regular training."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Really...?!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Step by step, of course. I've already 
discussed the details 
with your Trainer, so I'll leave the 
pacing in their hands."
choice_data_list: Understood, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, you should make it in time 
for your goal race... 
Though we'll keep up regular checkups to 
monitor your progress."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much! 
I'll continue to be in your care...!"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"I must admit, I'm astonished. I never 
expected such 
a rapid recovery... Horse girls truly are 
full of wonders."
choice_data_list: No, maybe Tact herself is the true wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she transforms expectations, 
gratitude, 
and everything else into pure strength—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is an extraordinarily powerful horse 
girl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm finally back...!
choice_data_list: Full-scale training starts tomorrow!
Full-scale training starts tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't much time before the Victoria 
Mile. 
Getting her running feel back, devising 
race strategies... 
We had plenty on our plate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet there was no need to worry. During 
this recuperation period, 
we had already thoroughly prepared our 
race strategies.
choice_data_list:
All that's left is for you to give it 
everything you've got.

All that's left is for you to give it 
everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. 
Please don't hold back in training!"
